product.description: A cloud-native, real-time, digital-first credit card processing system designed for mobile capabilities and scalability.

product.name: Mobile App/SDK
product.description: A branded native mobile app or SDK for integration, enabling cardholder management and interaction.

product.name: Servicing
product.description: A comprehensive credit card program management suite including disputes, payments, credit reporting, and rewards.

product.name: Origination
product.description: Credit underwriting and fraud control system using credit bureau, cash flow, and proprietary data for consumer and commercial applications.

product.name: Open APIs & SDKs
product.description: Developer-friendly APIs and SDKs for underwriting, KYC/KYB, servicing, card processing, and program setup integration.
